rules.statement: A plaintiff who has commenced an action under section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code to challenge a seizure and sale of property is entitled to a declaration that, as at the date of the action, the property was not liable to be seized and sold in execution of a writ, even if the sale has since taken place.
rules.supporting_quote: "It seems to me that, when the Judge found that the plaintiff's immovable property had been wrongfully seized and sold to pay another's debt, he ought to have given the plaintiff judgment in the action: he ought to have given him a declaration that at the date of the action the property was not liable to be seized and sold in execution of the defendant's writ, and left the plaintiff to get such benefit from that declaration as he could."
